description: The plot illustrates training loss as a function of iteration for six model variants listed in the legend (Vanilla, StrmLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64, H), SepLLM (n=64, H/T), and SepLLM (n=128)). The x-axis is labeled “#Iteration,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 0 to 140,000 with regularly spaced tick labels every 20,000. The y-axis is labeled “Loss,” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 2.4 to 3.4 with tick labels at 0.1 increments. Each series is drawn as a solid line with a semi-transparent band around it: Vanilla is purple and drops steeply from about 3.4 near iteration 0 to roughly 2.65 by ~20,000, then gradually declines to about 2.46–2.48 by 140,000; StrmLLM (n=64) is light blue and decreases from about 3.4 at the start to around 2.80 by ~20,000, then continues a slow decline to about 2.61–2.62 at 140,000; SepLLM (n=64) is orange and falls from about 3.4 initially to about 2.70 by ~20,000, then trends downward to roughly 2.52 by 140,000; SepLLM (n=64, H) is green and similarly drops from about 3.4 to about 2.69 by ~20,000 and then declines to around 2.51–2.52 by 140,000; SepLLM (n=64, H/T) is red and decreases from about 3.4 to about 2.67 by ~20,000 and then to about 2.49–2.50 by 140,000; SepLLM (n=128) is dark blue and drops from about 3.4 to about 2.68 by ~20,000 and then gradually declines to about 2.50 by 140,000.
